main_text.head: In eòídem Cardinales.

p.i: Quod scribus illis, Papa quarum est ianitor,
Quà lata Ditis ducit in demum Via,
At tu, tuorum liberator, ô Deus,
Vt iustus Vltor perdē, Verte, subrue
Hunc ianitorem, ipsas fores, hos cardines.

main_text.head: IVLIVS TERTIVS PAPA.

p.i: TErtius ad mensam quum Iulius ille sederet,
Impia quem potuit Roma necipsa pati,
Tres Vfus pelues interdum habuisse paratas,
Vt triplici triplex Vafe leuaret onus.
Vna alui podus, Vomitum altera peluis habebat,
I nunc, Pontifices, Germane insane negato
Omnia posse suo promere iura sinu.

main_text.p: In Beatæ virginis statuam argenteam à Francisco I. in priuatæ domus angulo, Lutetiæ propè templum parui, quod vocant Antonij, saxeæ alterius loco, adhibito ferreo clauftro confecratam, cuius

page.notes: The last word "ius" at the foot is a catchword-like continuation; it is printed below the final line. Some letters in the verse are blurred; "Vfus", "Vafe", "Vomitum" and "perdē" are doubtful readings. The page header "THEOD. BEZÆ" is shown as running head.
